#   NBP: net biome production, includes fire, landuse, and harvest flux, positive for sink (monthly mean, gC/m^2/s)

#   HR: total heterotrophic respiration (monthly sum, gC/m2/month)
#   FSH: sensible heat (monthly mean, W/m^2)
#   EFLX_LH_TOT: total latent heat flux [+ to atm] (monthly mean, W/m^2)
#   FPSN: photosynthesis (mean daily flux, umol/m2/day)
#   TOTSOMC: total soil organic matter carbon (monthly mean, gC/m^2)
#   TOTVEGC: total vegetation carbon, excluding cpool (monthly mean, gC/m^2)
#   TOTECOSYSC: total ecosystem carbon, incl veg but excl cpool but excl product pools (monthly mean, gC/m^2)
#
